<!--
  A row of vertical bars (sales by day, orders by week) with a caption under each bar. The chart is one image
  for assistive technology: `label` carries the summary, the bar values are in the captions and titles.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Bar } from "./bar-chart.types";

export type BarChartProps = {
  bars: Bar[];
  label: string;
  max?: number;
  height?: number;
  class?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const { bars, label, max, height = 160, class: className } = defineProps<BarChartProps>();
const top = computed(() => Math.max(1, (max ?? bars.reduce((m, i) => Math.max(m, i.value), 0))));
</script>

<template>
  <Box :class="cn('min-w-0', className)" data-slot="bar-chart">
    <Box class="flex min-w-0 items-end gap-2" role="img" :aria-label="label" :style="`height:${height}px`">
      <Box v-for="b in bars" :key="b.id" class="flex h-full min-w-0 flex-1 items-end" :title="(b.title ?? b.label)">
        <Box
          :class="cn('w-full rounded', (b.muted ? 'bg-muted-foreground' : 'bg-primary'))"
          :style="`height:${Math.max(2, Math.round(((b.value / top) * 100)))}%`"
          :data-bar="b.id"
        />
      </Box>
    </Box>
    <Box class="mt-2 flex min-w-0 gap-2" aria-hidden="true">
      <Box v-for="b in bars" :key="b.id" class="relative h-4 min-w-0 flex-1">
        <Text :class="'absolute left-1/2 top-0 m-0 -translate-x-1/2 whitespace-nowrap text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground'">
          {{ b.label }}
        </Text>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  </Box>
</template>
